answer: An operator copying one text across 174 aliases as a result pays for 174 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the walnut hash is stored at intake, the oasis graph groups the endorsements and the ripple audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
